title: Generative Cinematographer: Composing Camera and Object Motion in 3D

paragraphs.en: Current controllable video generation systems often rely on 2D motion trajectories or sparse drag signals for object motion. These controls are ambiguous because the same 2D trajectory can correspond to different 3D motions, especially when the camera and objects move simultaneously. We present Generative Cinematographer (GenCine), a system that lifts a single image into an editable 3D scene scaffold where artists jointly author camera and foreground motion. Artists specify a camera path and move selected foreground regions using local 3D motion handles. Several handles can move different parts of a subject independently, providing a piecewise-rigid approximation to non-rigid motion without a physics simulator or category-specific prior. To communicate these controls to a pretrained video model, we project them into guidance maps. These maps record where the controlled regions appear in each frame, assign each handle a fixed color across frames and encode the current 3D positions of its controlled points in the same world coordinate system as the background. This lets us describe object motion relative to the scene even as the camera moves. For training, we recover controls from the motion observed in real videos and use ground-truth geometry and trajectories from synthetic videos. We train a lightweight guidance branch and LoRA adapters on a pretrained Wan model to follow these controls. Our experiments show consistent camera-relative motion, improved geometric consistency under viewpoint changes, and strong controllability across diverse real-world scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的可控视频生成系统通常依赖二维运动轨迹或稀疏的拖拽信号来控制物体运动。 这些控制存在歧义，因为同一条二维轨迹可能对应不同的三维运动，尤其是在相机与物体同时运动的情况下。 我们提出生成式电影摄影系统（Generative Cinematographer, GenCine），该系统将单张图像提升为可编辑的三维场景骨架，使艺术家能够在其中同时设计相机与前景运动。 艺术家指定相机路径，并使用局部三维运动控制柄移动选定的前景区域。 多个控制柄可以独立地移动主体的不同部分，从而在无需物理模拟器或类别特定先验的情况下，对非刚性运动提供分段刚性的近似。 为了将这些控制传递给预训练视频模型，我们将其投影为引导图。 这些引导图记录受控区域在每一帧中出现的位置，为每个控制柄在所有帧中分配固定的颜色，并在与背景相同的世界坐标系中编码其受控点的当前三维位置。 这使我们能够在相机运动的情况下，依然相对于场景来描述物体运动。 在训练方面，我们从真实视频中观测到的运动中恢复控制信号，并使用来自合成视频的真值几何与轨迹。 我们在预训练的 Wan 模型上训练一个轻量级引导分支和 LoRA 适配器，以遵循这些控制。 我们的实验表明，该方法在相机相对运动上保持一致，在视角变化下具有更好的几何一致性，并在多样的真实场景中具备强可控性。

paragraphs.en: “Just as one can compose colors, or forms, so one can compose motions.” — Alexander Calder (1933)
paragraphs.zh: “正如人们可以组合色彩、组合形式一样，人们也可以组合运动。” — 亚历山大·考尔德（1933）

paragraphs.en: Composing a cinematic shot means deciding how the camera and the subjects move together. Classical graphics systems such as the Virtual Cinematographer ( He et al., 1996 ) compose shots by controlling a camera within a modeled 3D scene. We bring this world-space approach to video generation, allowing artists to jointly author camera and object motion using a 3D scaffold lifted from a single image (Fig. 1 ). Generative video models can now synthesize plausible motion from a single image, but giving artists precise control over these movements remains difficult. Text prompts can describe an action but leave its precise path unspecified. Likewise, a 2D drag may correspond to several 3D motions or mix object movement with a change in viewpoint (Fig. 2 ). A generated video can therefore look plausible while following a different motion from the one the artist intended.
paragraphs.zh: 构建电影感镜头意味着决定摄影机与被摄对象如何共同运动。 诸如虚拟摄影（Virtual Cinematographer）（He 等，1996）之类的经典图形系统，通过在建模的 3D 场景中控制摄影机来构建镜头。 我们将这种世界空间方法引入视频生成，让艺术家能够使用从单张图像提升得到的 3D 脚手架来联合创作摄影机与物体运动（图 1）。 生成式视频模型如今可以从单张图像合成合理的运动，但让艺术家对这些运动进行精确控制仍然困难。 文本提示可以描述一个动作，但无法指定其精确路径。 同样，一次 2D 拖拽可能对应多种 3D 运动，或把物体运动与视角变化混在一起（图 2）。 因此，生成的视频可能看起来合理，却遵循了与艺术家意图不同的运动。

paragraphs.en: Many controllable video methods specify foreground motion through pixel displacements ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Geng et al., 2024 ) , leaving the underlying 3D motion implicit. Physics simulators and category-specific priors provide additional structure ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025b ) , but their applicability depends on the materials and objects they support. Learning 3D control from videos presents a further challenge: reliable 3D motion annotations are scarce. Synthetic data provide these annotations but differ visually from real footage, while per-pixel 2D conditioning ( Chu et al., 2025 ) leaves artists working in image space.
paragraphs.zh: 许多可控视频方法通过像素位移指定前景运动（Wu et al., 2024; Geng et al., 2024），使得底层的三维运动保持隐式。 物理模拟器和类别特定的先验提供了额外的结构（Liu et al., 2024; Li et al., 2025b），但其适用性取决于它们所支持的材料和物体。 从视频中学习三维控制还面临一个进一步的挑战：可靠的三维运动标注非常稀缺。 合成数据可以提供这些标注，但在视觉上与真实素材存在差异，而逐像素的二维条件控制（Chu et al., 2025）则让艺术家只能在图像空间中工作。

paragraphs.en: A natural way to express the intended motion is to place the camera and subjects in a shared 3D scene. Camera paths then describe how the viewpoint changes, while object trajectories describe how the scene itself changes. We follow this approach in Generative Cinematographer (GenCine). Starting from a single image, we lift the scene into a colored point cloud. The artist selects a few foreground regions and specifies how each should move in 3D, along with a camera path. Each selected region acts as a motion handle : its points move together as a rigid group. Several handles can move different parts of a subject independently, providing a piecewise-rigid approximation to non-rigid motion without a skeleton, physics simulator, or category-specific prior.
paragraphs.zh: 表达预期运动的一种自然方式是将摄像机和被摄对象放置在同一个共享的 3D 场景中。 摄像机路径描述视点如何变化，而物体轨迹描述场景本身如何变化。 我们在 Generative Cinematographer（GenCine）中遵循这一方法。 从单张图像出发，我们将场景提升为彩色点云。 艺术家选择若干前景区域，并指定每个区域在 3D 中应如何运动，同时指定一条摄像机路径。 每个被选中的区域充当一个运动控制柄：其上的点作为一个刚体组一起运动。 多个控制柄可以独立地移动同一主体的不同部分，从而在不依赖骨架、物理模拟器或类别特定先验的情况下，为非刚性运动提供分段刚性的近似。

paragraphs.en: A pretrained video model does not directly interpret a camera path or a collection of 3D point trajectories. We need a representation that fits its image-based input while retaining what the controls mean. Recent methods support joint camera and object control ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) ; VerseCrafter, for example, uses RGB and depth maps of a background point cloud and object-level Gaussian trajectories. Our representation separates three questions: where does a region appear, which region is it, and how does it move in the world? First, we view the scene through the specified camera at each frame, placing guidance at the projected locations of background and handle points. Second, a fixed color identifies each handle across frames. Third, separate colors encode the current 3D positions of foreground points and the fixed positions of background points. These form the foreground identity, foreground XYZ, and background XYZ maps. The two XYZ maps use the same world frame and scale: camera motion changes where a static point appears, whereas object motion also changes its world position. This distinction preserves information that a 2D trajectory alone discards.

paragraphs.en: We construct these guidance sequences for each training clip and encode them with the pretrained video model’s frozen video autoencoder. The diffusion model learns to generate the paired video from its first frame, text, and encoded guidance. We train a lightweight side branch and LoRA adapters while keeping the base model weights frozen, allowing the model to learn control without retraining its visual prior. At inference, an artist’s camera path and handle trajectories pass through the same map construction in place of recovered motion. Varying the number and placement of training handles exposes the model to the sparse, partial controls available during authoring.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为每个训练片段构建这些引导序列，并使用预训练视频模型的冻结视频自编码器对其进行编码。 扩散模型学习根据第一帧、文本和编码后的引导来生成配对视频。 我们训练一个轻量级侧分支和 LoRA 适配器，同时保持基础模型权重冻结，使模型无需重新训练其视觉先验即可学习控制。 在推理时，艺术家的相机路径和手柄轨迹会通过相同的地图构建来替代恢复的运动。 改变训练手柄的数量和位置，使模型接触到创作过程中可用的稀疏、部分控制。

sents.zh: 我们为每个训练片段构建这些引导序列，并使用预训练视频模型的冻结视频自编码器对其进行编码。

sents.en: The diffusion model learns to generate the paired video from its first frame, text, and encoded guidance.
sents.zh: 扩散模型学习根据第一帧、文本和编码后的引导来生成配对视频。

sents.en: We train a lightweight side branch and LoRA adapters while keeping the base model weights frozen, allowing the model to learn control without retraining its visual prior.
sents.zh: 我们训练一个轻量级侧分支和 LoRA 适配器，同时保持基础模型权重冻结，使模型无需重新训练其视觉先验即可学习控制。

sents.en: At inference, an artist’s camera path and handle trajectories pass through the same map construction in place of recovered motion.
sents.zh: 在推理时，艺术家的相机路径和手柄轨迹会通过相同的地图构建来替代恢复的运动。

sents.en: Varying the number and placement of training handles exposes the model to the sparse, partial controls available during authoring.
sents.zh: 改变训练手柄的数量和位置，使模型接触到创作过程中可用的稀疏、部分控制。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are: (1) a visual guidance representation for 3D motion that preserves handle identity and foreground–background positions in a shared world frame while remaining compatible with pretrained video models; (2) a local 3D motion-handle formulation that approximates non-rigid motion through independently controlled local rigid regions, without requiring a simulator or category-specific prior; and (3) a shared training and authoring pipeline that learns from videos paired with 3D motion controls and generates videos from a single image using artist-authored camera paths and local object trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献是：(1) 一种用于三维运动的视觉引导表示，它在共享世界坐标系中保留手柄身份与前景–背景位置关系，同时与预训练视频模型兼容；(2) 一种局部三维运动手柄的建模方法，通过独立控制的局部刚性区域来近似非刚性运动，无需模拟器或特定类别的先验；(3) 一个共享的训练与创作流程，它从与三维运动控制配对的视频中学习，并利用艺术家创作的相机路径和局部物体轨迹从单张图像生成视频。

paragraphs.en: The graphics community has long studied camera motion authoring. The Virtual Cinematographer ( He et al., 1996 ) formalized shot composition as cinematographic idioms. Later work extended this to declarative camera planning ( Christianson et al., 1996 ) and procedural camera control ( Drucker et al., 1992 ) . These systems assume a fully modeled 3D scene. In contrast, GenCine uses a 3D scaffold lifted from a single image to control the video generator.

paragraphs.en: MotionCtrl ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and CameraCtrl ( He et al., 2025a ; He et al., 2025b ) condition generation on camera poses. GEN3C ( Ren et al., 2025 ) renders a depth-derived 3D cache under target poses, while DimensionX ( Sun et al., 2025 ) generates 3D and 4D scenes from one image. WorldReel ( Fang et al., 2025 ) jointly generates RGB frames, point maps, camera trajectories, and flow for geometric and motion consistency. Generative Camera Dolly ( Van Hoorick et al., 2024 ) , TrajectoryCrafter ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , and FreeOrbit4D ( Cao et al., 2026 ) redirect viewpoints in existing videos, with FreeOrbit4D reconstructing a geometry-complete 4D proxy. Vista4D ( Lin et al., 2026 ) reshoots source videos using rendered 4D point clouds with temporally persistent static points. MotionCtrl also supports object control; CineMaster ( Wang et al., 2025c ) uses 3D box layouts, and Diffusion as Shader ( Gu et al., 2025 ) uses 3D tracking videos for joint control.
paragraphs.zh: MotionCtrl（Wang 等，2024）与 CameraCtrl（He 等，2025a；He 等，2025b）以相机位姿为条件进行生成。 GEN3C（Ren 等，2025）在目标位姿下渲染由深度导出的 3D 缓存，而 DimensionX（Sun 等，2025）则从单张图像生成 3D 与 4D 场景。 WorldReel（Fang 等，2025）联合生成 RGB 帧、点图、相机轨迹以及光流，以实现几何与运动上的一致性。 Generative Camera Dolly（Van Hoorick 等，2024）、TrajectoryCrafter（Yu 等，2025）以及 FreeOrbit4D（Cao 等，2026）对现有视频中的视角进行重定向，其中 FreeOrbit4D 会重建几何完整的 4D 代理。 Vista4D（Lin 等，2026）利用具有时间持久静态点的渲染 4D 点云对源视频进行重拍。 MotionCtrl 还支持物体控制；CineMaster（Wang 等，2025c）使用 3D 框布局，而 Diffusion as Shader（Gu 等，2025）则使用 3D 跟踪视频进行联合控制。

paragraphs.en: GenCine learns to generate a video from a reference image, a camera path, and local foreground trajectories. Training controls are recovered from videos; inference controls are supplied by the artist. Both pass through the same three steps (Fig. 3 ): (i) Place the controls in each view. Project background and handle points through the specified camera so the model knows where guidance applies. (ii) Preserve identity and 3D motion. Use fixed handle colors to identify regions across frames and separate XYZ maps to describe their positions relative to the static scene. (iii) Learn to follow the guidance. Encode the maps with the frozen video autoencoder and train adaptation modules on paired videos, reference images, and controls.
paragraphs.zh: GenCine 学习从参考图像、相机路径和局部前景轨迹生成视频。 训练控制信号从视频中恢复；推理控制信号由艺术家提供。 两者都经过相同的三步（图 3）：(i) 将控制信号放置到每个视图中。 通过指定的相机投影背景和控制点，使模型知道引导应作用在哪里。 (ii) 保持身份和三维运动。 使用固定的控制点颜色在帧间标识区域，并用分离的 XYZ 图描述它们相对于静态场景的位置。 (iii) 学习遵循引导。 用冻结的视频自编码器对这些图进行编码，并在成对的视频、参考图像和控制信号上训练适配模块。

paragraphs.en: The motion representation in GenCine follows two principles: explicit correspondence and local rigidity. The first is motivated by motion correspondence in human visual perception ( Ullman, 1979 ; Dawson, 1991 ) ; the second allows a few local controls to approximate complex foreground deformation ( Sumner et al., 2007 ; Sorkine & Alexa, 2007 ) .
paragraphs.zh: GenCine 中的运动表示遵循两个原则：显式对应与局部刚性。 第一个原则的动机来自人类视觉感知中的运动对应（Ullman, 1979；Dawson, 1991）；第二个原则则允许用少量局部控制来近似复杂的前景形变（Sumner et al., 2007；Sorkine & Alexa, 2007）。

paragraphs.en: In summary, the maps provide complementary correspondence and motion cues. The background XYZ map supplies a static world reference for camera motion. paragraphs.en: We compare with Wan2.1 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and five controllable video generation methods. In our evaluation, ATI ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , Wan-Move ( Chu et al., 2025 ) , and Go-with-the-Track ( Namekata et al., 2026 ) receive dense 2D foreground and background trajectories extracted from ground-truth videos. VerseCrafter ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) and SymphoMotion ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) provide camera control and coarse object-level motion control. GenCine uses sparse 3D motion handles and a target camera trajectory derived from the same reference motion. Dense ground-truth trajectories are unavailable when authoring new motion from a single image; a similar input asymmetry is discussed in concurrent work ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Fig. 5 compares GenCine with three baselines on artist-authored examples. In Living room, GenCine moves the green tunnel with less distortion than Wan-Move and VerseCrafter. In Bus, GenCine coordinates the intended turn with camera pullback, while VerseCrafter largely retains the bus’s initial orientation. Robotic arm further illustrates motion dependencies between connected parts. Go-with-the-Track moves the gripper region but leaves most of the arm static, while VerseCrafter introduces extraneous boxes. GenCine follows the end-effector path while articulating the connected arm segments. This coordinated response suggests that GenCine can infer motion dependencies within an articulated structure, using sparse local guidance to generate motion beyond the directly controlled region.

paragraphs.en: We presented GenCine, a system for jointly authoring camera and object motion in a shared 3D world lifted from a single image. Its guidance maps encode static background coordinates, persistent foreground handle identities, and current world-space positions in a form compatible with pretrained video diffusion models. This representation makes the intended 3D motion explicit where image-space trajectories alone leave it ambiguous. Our results show that a few local handles can compose camera and foreground motion, including a piecewise-rigid approximation to articulated motion, through lightweight adaptation of a pretrained video generator.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 GenCine，一个用于在从单张图像提升出的共享 3D 世界中联合创作相机运动与物体运动的系统。 其引导图以与预训练视频扩散模型兼容的形式，编码了静态背景坐标、持久的前景控制柄身份以及当前的世界空间位置。 这一表示使预期的 3D 运动变得明确，而仅靠图像空间轨迹则会使其含糊不清。 我们的结果表明，通过对预训练视频生成器进行轻量级适配，少量局部控制柄即可组合相机运动与前景运动，包括对关节运动的分段刚性近似。

paragraphs.en: The single-image scaffold leaves occluded regions unmodeled, requiring the generator to synthesize unseen surfaces under large viewpoint changes. Local rigid handles are better suited to articulated motion than to fracture, tearing, or fluid dynamics, and authoring many handles can become cumbersome for distributed deformation. Independently authored handles also impose no physical constraints or causal interactions between objects. Geometry completion, automatic handle placement, and learned interaction priors could extend the range of shots artists can compose.
paragraphs.zh: 单图像骨架无法对被遮挡区域进行建模，这要求生成器在大幅度视角变化下合成不可见的表面。 局部刚性控制柄更适合铰接运动，而不适合断裂、撕裂或流体动力学，而且为分布式变形创建大量控制柄可能变得繁琐。 独立创建的控制柄也不会在物体之间施加物理约束或因果交互。 几何补全、自动控制柄放置以及学习到的交互先验可以扩展艺术家能够创作的镜头范围。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 7 examines an edit that moves a teapot toward the camera while preserving its orientation in world space. Image-plane trajectories constrain projected motion but do not uniquely specify the underlying 3D transformation. In this example, Wan-Move produces geometrically inconsistent motion across the sampled frames. In GenCine, 3D handles specify the intended displacement in the canonical world frame, and the generated sequence better preserves the teapot’s orientation and scene geometry. This example illustrates the benefit of making the intended 3D motion explicit when different spatial motions can have similar image-plane projections.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 展示了一个将茶壶朝摄像机方向移动、同时保持其在世界空间中朝向不变的编辑示例。 图像平面上的轨迹约束了投影运动，但并不能唯一确定其底层的 3D 变换。 在此示例中，Wan-Move 在采样帧之间产生了几何上不一致的运动。 在 GenCine 中，3D 控制柄在规范的世界坐标系中指定预期的位移，生成的序列更好地保留了茶壶的朝向和场景几何。 此示例说明，当不同的空间运动可能具有相似的图像平面投影时，显式表达预期的 3D 运动所带来的好处。

paragraphs.en: We use Wan2.1-Fun-V1.1-14B-Control ( Wan et al., 2025 ) as the latent video diffusion backbone. sents.en: In the 3D viewport, the artist selects foreground regions as motion handles and authors their trajectories together with a camera path using keyframes or drawn paths.
sents.zh: 在 3D 视口中，艺术家选择前景区域作为运动操控点，并通过关键帧或绘制的路径为这些操控点连同相机路径一起创作轨迹。

sents.en: Both controls use the same canonical world frame.
sents.zh: 两种控制都使用同一个规范的世界坐标系。

paragraphs.en: Monocular depth estimation can fail on reflective or transparent surfaces and thin structures. Errors in the lifted point cloud propagate to the background XYZ map and can cause geometric inconsistencies during viewpoint changes. Even with accurate visible geometry, the single-image scaffold leaves occluded surfaces unmodeled; the generator must synthesize them as they become visible.
paragraphs.zh: 单目深度估计在反射或透明表面以及细小结构上可能失效。 提升后的点云中的误差会传播到背景 XYZ 图，并可能在视角变化时导致几何不一致。 即使可见几何是准确的，单图像骨架也无法对被遮挡的表面进行建模；生成器必须在这些表面变得可见时将其合成出来。

paragraphs.en: Each authored handle moves its selected points as a rigid group. Multiple handles can approximate articulated motion, but fracture, tearing, and fluid dynamics remain difficult. More handles allow finer control at the cost of additional authoring effort. Independently authored handles impose neither physical constraints nor causal interactions between objects, as discussed in Sec. 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 每个手动创建的操控柄将其选中的点作为一个刚性整体来移动。 多个操控柄可以近似模拟关节式运动，但断裂、撕裂和流体动力学仍然难以实现。 更多的操控柄能带来更精细的控制，但代价是额外的工作量。 如第 5 节所述，独立创建的操控柄既不施加物理约束，也不在物体之间引入因果交互。

paragraphs.en: Both XYZ maps use the first-frame scene bounding box (Eq. 9 ). Points within this box map to [ 0 , 1 ] 3 [0,1]^{3} , but a handle driven outside it can produce foreground XYZ values outside this range. Authoring within the scene extent keeps the guidance values in the RGB range; we expose the per-axis scale to the artist in the UI as a visual cue.
paragraphs.zh: 两个XYZ贴图均使用第一帧的场景包围盒（式 9）。 该包围盒内的点映射到 [0,1]^3，但被驱动到盒外的控制柄可能产生超出该范围的前景XYZ值。 在场景范围内进行创作可将引导值保持在RGB范围内；我们在UI中向艺术家展示各轴的缩放作为视觉提示。
